description: This file contains test cases for concept vocabulary functions, including deriving concept tags from multilingual snippets, classifying script types, and summarizing script coverage.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Sets up a test suite with a description label.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an expectation object for assertions.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case with a description and test function.

methods.name: classifyConceptTagScript
methods.description: Classifies the script type of a given concept tag (latin, cjk, or mixed).

methods.name: deriveConceptTags
methods.description: Extracts concept tags from a given snippet and path, supporting multiple languages and scripts.

methods.name: summarizeConceptTagScriptCoverage
methods.description: Provides a summary count of entries across different script types.
